metadata.date_window: 2024-01-01 through latest available in source extract
metadata.rate_key: ProcedureCode + raw Payer before payer consolidation
metadata.reporting_consolidation: canonical payer mapping is applied after line-level Expected Pay is calculated

filters_applied.expected_rate_training_rows: NetRevenue > 0 and UnitVolume > 0; open balances included

metadata.method: Raw-payer largest-dollar credible bucket expected rate. Group NetRevenue/UnitVolume into 2% buckets by ProcedureCode + raw Payer. Select the credible bucket with the largest total NetRevenue, requiring at least 3 rows. Use the median rate inside that selected bucket. Fallbacks: procedure+raw payer median, procedure+raw payer category largest-dollar bucket/median, procedure overall largest-dollar bucket/median.
metadata.expected_pay_application: Line-level Expected Pay is capped at GrossRevenue. If GrossRevenue is nonzero and calculated Expected Pay is zero, Expected Pay is floored to 80% of GrossRevenue.
metadata.va_ccn_optum_expected_floor: For raw payer VA CCN OPTUM, Expected Pay is at least 80% of GrossRevenue before the GrossRevenue cap.
metadata.no_rate_government_medicare_floor: For no-rate rows in Medicare, Medicare Advantage, or Government Other categories, Expected Pay is at least 80% of GrossRevenue.
metadata.global_nonzero_gross_expected_floor: For any report line with GrossRevenue > 0 and calculated Expected Pay <= 0, Expected Pay is set to 80% of GrossRevenue before the GrossRevenue cap.
metadata.aj_paid_receipt_augmentation: Rows are added only for missing A/J ProcedureCode + raw Payer combinations that have positive Receipt and UnitVolume in the detail file. selected_rate_per_unit is the median observed Receipt/UnitVolume.
metadata.amd_2026_expected_override: For 2026 AMD rows, payer reconciliation is applied first. For each ProcedureCode + consolidated payer, the runtime report uses the higher of the raw-payer matrix rate and the Tebra-preferred consolidated payer matrix rate selected by strongest pre-2026 positive-payment history. It defaults to 70% of GrossRevenue when no supported rate exists. Expected Pay is capped at 80% of GrossRevenue.
metadata.amd_2026_historical_rate_statistic: Expected reimbursement matrix rate from the Tebra payer variant with the most pre-2026 positive-payment observations; pre-2026 AMD history is used only when Tebra has no rate
metadata.amd_2026_historical_gross_coverage: 79.8% before final UniCode event assignment using historically supported consolidated payer + ProcedureCode matrix rates
metadata.amd_2026_final_expected_to_gross: 77.5% in historical_charges_breakdown_unicode_final.xlsx after consolidated/Tebra-backed rate floor update
metadata.runtime_expected_rate_application: As of 2026-07-06, the final UniCode workbook applies payer reconciliation before expected-rate lookup for all report years. For each ProcedureCode + consolidated payer, the runtime lookup uses the Tebra-preferred historical matrix rate selected by strongest pre-2026 positive-payment history, while keeping the current raw-payer matrix rate as a floor so consolidation can increase but not reduce Expected Pay.
metadata.legacy_expected_reconciliation: Disabled as of 2026-07-06; final workbook Expected Pay is no longer scaled to older Procedure Monthly workbook expected totals.
